items.text: Came back to the game for the 1.0 launch, and I've been enjoying it. As others have noted, there are concerning bugs, but I've not encountered too many. I'm playing without any additional crew, as I've heard they can lead to performance and other issues. The core experience of scavenging ships in space has been slow but pretty fun, and I'm eager to try some of the other stuff available in-game. The character creator could definitely use some work, but I'd recommend engaging with it to ensure you play a good character if you plan on making a long run--age and injury in particular are worth avoiding.
items.text_zh: 为了1.0发布回归了这款游戏，我一直玩得很开心。正如其他人所指出的，有一些令人担忧的bug，但我没遇到太多。我在没有任何额外船员的情况下游玩，因为我听说他们可能导致性能和其他问题。在太空中打捞飞船的核心体验一直很慢，但相当有趣，我渴望尝试游戏内可用的其他一些内容。角色创建器肯定还需要一些改进，但如果你打算进行长期游玩，我建议你认真对待它，以确保你扮演一个好角色——尤其是年龄和伤病值得避免。

items.text:
Oh great... Yet another dystopian game where the first thing thrust into your face upon loading is a pronoun selector with a third option, and an utterly atrocious character creation screen. Remember back when you could make male characters who actually looked masculine, or female characters who looked feminine? Well, you can't in this game. Pandering, at the expense of realism.

I don't understand this type of sci-fi setting design at all. What sort of fantasy is this, if it can even be called one? Why would a person ever play, let alone make, a game where you can only play as a hideously ugly, genetically-deformed, sexually-and-racially-ambiguous corporate slave? Maybe this genre could be called an "anti-fantasy" of sorts, or "loserpunk," or "Amazonpunk," or something like that, but I digress. I understand this specific subgenre of dystopian game will appeal to some people, and I respect that. That being said, games with this exact setting design are a dime a dozen nowadays. There is almost nothing original left that you can do with this concept... Not to mention, any alternative to this title, which features the same kind of writing, would likely be cheaper to buy and more polished to play. $20.00 USD is an awful lot of money to pay for an Early Access title with a miserable setting, that just reads like one giant complaint against postmodern living. If ironic satire were entirely the point of this type of setting, I'd be much more understanding of it, and I'd even be willing to embrace it as something new within itself. In fact, all of the pandering would only make it funnier. But, the developer is clearly playing these tropes straight, and it's evident by his writing. For example, the idea of so-called ""eldritch"" meat monsters created by lab-grown meat from human-goat hybrids was a really funny concept. If he had left it there, it would've been a hilarious case of "science run amok," a la Soylent Green. That was, until it became apparent that there was some genuine eldritch phenomenon going on, and all of the sudden you need to kill a goat demon for his epic bone scepter weapon. UTTER SLOP! A third grader could produce better writing than this!

On a much more positive note: There is actually a lot to love here gameplay-wise... At least, from what I've seen in YouTube videos! Seriously, if you are just here for the shipbuilding gameplay, then ignore everything that I just wrote. Watch a video and decide for yourself if this game is worth a try. The only thing is, you won't be able to access any of the gameplay unless you can first figure out how to leave your ship. Good luck doing that on your own in under 2 hours and leaving yourself with enough time to decide if you like this game enough to keep it, before your return period expires. It is no exaggeration to say that this game's systems are so involved that it could, in some ways, be compared to titles like Dwarf Fortress or Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead. Unfortunately, as is the case with DF, this game's instructions are bolted-on at best, and terrible at worst... And unlike the case with DF, there is nothing as robust as DF Wiki to back you up if you don't understand something. I guess if you have a few hundred hours to throw at a screen, and you can get past sloppy, unoriginal, and obviously "woke" writing, the game's intricate systems really are a fitting reward. People are complaining about bugs, but the game is Early Access. Of course there will be bugs! Most good games have bugs at some point in their development! This is one area where I'd advise patience to the player. But even if I put the bugs and my many complaints about the setting entirely aside as well, I do not think the game is truly "playable" in this state either, because of the lack of clear and precise instructions. It's sort of like being thrown into a flight simulator without any sense of what the controls do.

TL;DR: $20?! Not even close! This developer chronically overcharges for their games, and that is a steep price to pay in order to be so miserable with what you've bought. I will probably refund this game, and consider picking it back up if the character creator and instructions improve. I am just so sick of this kind of junk from developers... Pronoun Selector? Check. Instructions? NO, LOL. Would rather spend my evening watching someone else play this. For whatever it's worth, this game is obviously a lot better than their previous creation, Neo Scavenger (which is also criminally overpriced at $15.00 USD.) If you can tolerate some poor writing/ setting design, and can bear the pain of learning how to play a very involved game with minimal instructions, then I'd say to watch a video first before deciding if you should try it. And if you do decide to try it, then make sure you learn about the controls first via a third-party source before trying it... Awkward as that may sound.
items.text_zh:
哦，太好了……又是一个反乌托邦游戏，加载后第一件怼到你脸上的东西就是一个带有第三选项的代词选择器，以及一个糟糕透顶的角色创建界面。还记得以前你可以创建看起来真正有男子气概的男性角色，或者看起来有女性气质的女性角色吗？好吧，在这个游戏里你做不到。为了迎合而牺牲了真实感。

我完全无法理解这种科幻设定设计。这算是什么幻想，如果它还能被称为幻想的话？为什么有人会去玩，更别说去制作一个只能扮演一个丑陋得可怕、基因畸形、性别和种族模糊的企业奴隶的游戏？也许这种类型可以被称为某种“反幻想”，或者“失败者朋克”，或者“亚马逊朋克”之类的，但我跑题了。我理解这种特定的反乌托邦游戏子类型会吸引某些人，我尊重这一点。话虽如此，如今采用这种确切设定设计的游戏多如牛毛。用这个概念几乎做不出什么原创的东西了……更不用说，任何具有同样类型写作的同类替代品，很可能买起来更便宜，玩起来也更精致。20.00美元对于一款抢先体验版游戏来说是一大笔钱，设定又令人痛苦，读起来就像一篇针对后现代生活的巨大抱怨。如果讽刺性的戏仿完全是这种设定类型的目的，我会更理解它，甚至愿意把它当作某种新东西来接受。事实上，所有的迎合只会让它更好笑。但是，开发者显然是在严肃地使用这些套路，从他的写作中就能看出来。例如，所谓“诡异”的肉怪是由人羊杂交种的实验室培育肉创造出来的，这本来是个非常有趣的概念。如果他就此打住，那会是一个 hilarious 的“科学失控”案例，就像《绿色食品》那样。然而，后来变得明显的是，确实有某种真正的诡异现象在发生，突然间你就需要杀死一个山羊恶魔来获取他那史诗般的骨杖武器。完全是垃圾！一个三年级学生都能写出比这更好的东西！

从更积极的角度来说：在玩法方面这里其实有很多值得喜爱的地方……至少，从我在YouTube视频里看到的是这样！说真的，如果你只是冲着造船玩法来的，那就忽略我刚才写的一切。看个视频，自己决定这个游戏是否值得一试。唯一的问题是，除非你先弄清楚如何离开你的飞船，否则你无法接触到任何玩法。祝你在不到2小时内自己搞定这件事，并给自己留下足够的时间来决定你是否喜欢这个游戏到足以保留它，趁退货期还没过。毫不夸张地说，这个游戏的系统如此复杂，在某些方面可以比肩《矮人要塞》或《大灾变：黑暗之日》这样的作品。不幸的是，就像《矮人要塞》的情况一样，这个游戏的说明充其量是硬加上去的，最坏的情况则是糟糕透顶……而且与《矮人要塞》不同的是，如果你有什么不懂的地方，没有什么像《矮人要塞》Wiki那样强大的东西来支持你。我想，如果你有几百个小时可以扔在屏幕前，并且你能忍受草率、毫无原创性、明显“觉醒”的写作，那么这个游戏错综复杂的系统确实是一种相称的回报。人们在抱怨bug，但游戏是抢先体验版。当然会有bug！大多数好游戏在开发的某个阶段都有bug！这是我会建议玩家保持耐心的一点。但即使我把bug和我对设定的诸多抱怨完全放在一边，我也不认为游戏在这个状态下真正“可玩”，因为缺乏清晰精确的说明。这有点像被扔进一个飞行模拟器，却完全不知道控制键是干什么的。

TL;DR：20美元？！差得远呢！这个开发者对他们的游戏长期定价过高，为了买来的东西如此痛苦，这个价格太陡了。我可能会退款这个游戏，并考虑如果角色创建器和说明有所改善再重新拾起。我真是受够了开发者这种垃圾……代词选择器？有。说明？没有，哈哈。宁愿花一晚上看别人玩这个。不管怎样，这个游戏显然比他们之前的作品《新拾荒者》好得多（那个也定价过高，15.00美元简直是犯罪）。如果你能容忍一些糟糕的写作/设定设计，并能忍受学习一个说明极少的非常复杂游戏的痛苦，那么我会说先看个视频，再决定是否应该尝试。如果你决定尝试，那么确保先通过第三方来源了解控制键再试……听起来可能很别扭。
在开发的某个阶段都会有bug！这是我会建议玩家保持耐心的一点。但即使我把bug和我对设定的诸多抱怨完全放在一边，我也不认为游戏在这个状态下真正“可玩”，因为缺乏清晰而精确的说明。这有点像被扔进一个飞行模拟器，却完全不知道各个控制键是干什么的。

长话短说：20美元？！差得远了！这个开发者长期对自己的游戏定价过高，而为了买到手后如此痛苦，这个价格实在太贵了。我可能会退款这款游戏，并考虑在角色创建器和说明改进后再重新入手。我真是受够了开发者这种垃圾……代词选择器？有。说明？没有，哈哈。我宁愿花一晚上看别人玩这个。不管怎么说，这款游戏显然比他们之前的作品《Neo Scavenger》好得多（那款也同样贵得离谱，要15.00美元。）如果你能容忍糟糕的写作/设定设计，并且能忍受在极少说明的情况下学习如何玩一款非常复杂的游戏的痛苦，那么我会说先看个视频，再决定要不要尝试。如果你确实决定尝试，那一定要先通过第三方来源了解操作方式再试……虽然这听起来很别扭。

items.text:
I held off for nearly two years writing this review because I liked NEO Scavenger a lot, and wished with all my heart that this game would come along or I’d come around, whichever first. But it’s simply never happened. Each update makes the game more miserable to play than the last and I don't think any amount of future updates can really address the fundamental issue of sheer antagonism toward the player.

You buy this expecting cool captain shenanigans; [i]yeah, man, I’m going to babysit a bunch of mentally ill crew members on a ship and maybe we’ll go stir crazy and kill each other, I’ll build my ship to look like a dong, wouldn’t that be funny, I'm gonna press all the buttons on the panel heh[/i], etc. But what you get is just… not fun.

Your first hurdle is character creation, where you can’t even see your character well because there is so much graffiti on the mirror. If you want to mod that out, assuming you know how, good luck tracking down ALL the assets to blank them because there’s an entire pool of them that randomizes each time you load a new save. This is, of course, assuming you can find the mirror in the first place as it’s not a clickable object on the wall, you must first have the insane presence of mind to right click the sink, select the sink, then select the mirror from there.

Have you ever made a character in Traveller? If you have, you sort of know already what you’re going to be getting here. If not, well, if you can get through this system that's like trying to ice skate uphill, you can get through character creation in Traveller. You will also find out during this portion that inventory is its own unique burden. Enjoy rerolling to get enough money to afford a backpack, in addition to the other things you do not know you will need to survive later. :)

Let’s fast forward and assume you have done everything “correct”, of which there is an actual correct way to do things in this game though you’d never know it without looking it up and you will probably need to reroll quite a few times to get there. You will now find yourself alone on a ship that needs to be repaired. This is now probably the sixth or seventh time you’ve alt-tabbed out to look up what you’re supposed to do and how to do it. After you’ve surmounted all these obstacles, it’s time to fly!

Flying is somehow worse than walking around. Imagine the floaty drunkenness of Asteroids but now you’re expected to thread a needle every time you want to dock. This is like a gear/skill check boss fight in an MMO, where its mere presence will make you sincerely question your desire to play this game. And you will have to do this every. single. time.

Once you manage to ram your ship into the other ship enough that you accidentally end up docking it, you will not understand how to salvage a ship. You’ll click on things and the game will complain you can’t do this or you don’t have the tool for that or something is too big or there’s no room. Quite tragically, once you figure all this out, you’ll also realise there’s not much else to this game at all.

If your idea of a fun afternoon is trying to solve the Lament Configuration, you'll probably really enjoy this game. But the end result is going to be exactly the same.
items.text_zh:
我拖了将近两年才写下这篇评测，因为我非常喜欢《NEO Scavenger》，并且全心全意地希望这款游戏能有所起色，或者我自己能回心转意，无论哪个先发生。但这一切从未发生。每次更新都让游戏比上一版更令人痛苦，而且我认为再多的未来更新也无法真正解决对玩家极度敌意这个根本问题。

你买这游戏时期待的是酷炫的船长胡闹；[i]是啊，老兄，我要在一艘船上照看一群精神有问题的船员，也许我们会发疯然后互相残杀，我会把我的船造得像个屌，那不好笑吗，我要按下控制面板上所有的按钮嘿嘿[/i]，等等。但你得到的只是……不好玩。

你的第一个障碍是角色创建，你甚至看不清自己的角色，因为镜子上有太多涂鸦。如果你想用模组去掉这些，假设你知道怎么做，祝你好运找到所有素材来清空它们，因为有一整组素材会在你每次加载新存档时随机化。当然，这是假设你能先找到镜子，因为它不是墙上可点击的物体，你必须先有疯狂的镇定，右键点击水槽，选择水槽，然后从那里选择镜子。

你在《Traveller》里创建过角色吗？如果你创建过，你大概已经知道这里会是什么样了。如果没有，那么，如果你能通过这个像试图在斜坡上滑冰一样的系统，你就能通过《Traveller》的角色创建。你还会在这部分发现，物品栏本身就是一种独特的负担。享受反复重掷来获得足够的钱买一个背包吧，此外还有那些你不知道以后生存会需要的其他东西。:)

让我们快进，假设你已经做完了所有“正确”的事，这游戏里确实有一种正确的做事方式，但你不查资料永远不会知道，而且你可能需要重掷很多次才能达到那一步。你现在会发现自己独自在一艘需要修理的船上。这大概已经是你第六次或第七次切出游戏去查你该做什么以及怎么做。在你克服了所有这些障碍之后，是时候起飞了！

飞行不知怎么比走路还糟。想象一下《Asteroids》那种飘忽的醉意，但现在你每次想停靠时都被期望要穿针引线。这就像MMO里的装备/技能检测Boss战，它的存在本身就会让你真心质疑自己想不想玩这个游戏。而且你每次都得这么做。每。一。次。

一旦你设法把你的船撞向另一艘船足够多次，以至于你不小心停靠上了，你也不会明白如何打捞一艘船。你会点击东西，然后游戏会抱怨你不能这么做，或者你没有那个工具，或者某个东西太大，或者没有空间。非常悲剧的是，一旦你搞明白这一切，你也会意识到这个游戏除此之外根本没什么内容。

如果你对一个有趣下午的定义是试图解开哀叹配置盒，你可能会真的很喜欢这个游戏。但最终结果将会完全一样。

items.text: Let me just say that this game is not for everyone. This game may be made by the same people who made NEO Scavenger, but the gameplay is a far cry from that of NS. And that isn't a bad thing. To put it simply, Ostranauts is a strategy/shipbuilding game set in space. The best equivalent I could draw is that it's a more complicated Starsector, with the top down perspective of SS13. The biggest issue that I have with this game is how buggy it is, but with an early access game that's to be expected, and the second biggest issue is how complicated it can be. The navigation systems can be intimidating, and figuring out how a reactor works (along with all the dials, sliders, and switches) can be scary and tedious. Aside from the very beginning there are virtually no tutorials (with the exception of the nav system cheatsheet) and you're left to your own devises past the initial character creation. That's another issue, the character creation. There are three options. Gender, name, and looks. But the only way to customize how you look is using the randomize button (as far as I can tell) and it can be quite annoying to have to keep clicking to find what you want. Another issue is that sometimes the floors on the derelict ships that you find will be totally screwed, and if you manage to dock with a ship on your first run and all of the batteries are dead then you might as well restart. The third issue for me is the batteries. The only way to recharge them is by using a reactor to charge them. Depending on the condition of the ship you dock with (and your nav skills) you might be totally marooned with no hope to recharge you batteries or drive away. There are more issues, but this is already way too long, but they're minor gripes along with everything else, and the devs are very committed and have been releasing patches daily for the past couple of days.TL;DR: Ostranauts is a diamond in the rough with a steep learning curve, however this diamond is uncut and uncircumcised. I wouldn't pay full price for this game in it's current state and recommend that you wait for a sale, or until the game has improved.I give this game a 7/10.
items.text_zh: 我只想说，这款游戏并不适合所有人。这款游戏可能出自制作《NEO Scavenger》的同一批人之手，但玩法与NS相去甚远。而这并不是坏事。简单来说，《Ostranauts》是一款设定在太空中的策略/造船游戏。我能想到的最贴切的类比是，它是一款更复杂的《Starsector》，采用《SS13》的俯视视角。我对这款游戏最大的问题是它有多少bug，但对于一款抢先体验游戏来说这是意料之中的，第二大问题是它可能有多复杂。导航系统可能令人望而生畏，弄清楚反应堆如何运作（连同所有的旋钮、滑块和开关）可能既吓人又繁琐。除了最开始之外，几乎没有教程（导航系统速查表除外），在初始角色创建之后你就只能靠自己摸索了。那又是另一个问题，角色创建。有三个选项。性别、名字和外观。但据我所知，自定义外观的唯一方法就是使用随机按钮，而且为了找到你想要的样子不得不一直点击，这相当烦人。另一个问题是，有时你找到的废弃飞船的地板会完全乱套，如果你第一次出航就成功对接了一艘飞船，而所有电池都没电了，那你不如直接重开。对我来说第三个问题是电池。给它们充电的唯一方法就是用反应堆来充。取决于你对接的飞船的状况（以及你的导航技能），你可能会完全被困住，毫无希望给电池充电或开走。还有更多问题，但这已经太长了，不过它们和其他一切一样都是些小抱怨，而且开发者非常投入，过去几天每天都在发布补丁。TL;DR：《Ostranauts》是一颗未经雕琢的钻石，学习曲线陡峭，然而这颗钻石未经切割也未受割礼。在当前状态下我不会为这款游戏付全价，建议你等打折，或者等游戏有所改进。我给这款游戏打7/10分。

observations.description: 角色外观只能通过随机按钮定制，很烦人

items.text:
This game is gonna need a lot of work. 

The first thing I did when I started up the game was try to design my own ship. Every time I would click, nothing would be placed and so I couldn't build my ship. Oh well I'll just play the game instead except because I had designed a ship with no parts, my spaceship had no parts which meant my character would automatically spawn in space with no spaceship. Fun times.

I had to uninstall then reinstall the game in hopes that the edited ship was not permanent. Luckily it was not but there were significantly limited options for character creation. Perhaps the other careers just aren't ready yet but it was aggravating to see the other options for careers and not be able to play them. 

I designed my character, had a few options for how to set myself up, was bothered that I couldn't carry everything I bought at the trader station so it just left my items on the ground rather than bringing them to my ship. I finally get to see the incredibly small & puny ship. It was just pathetic but I decided to persevere and started driving the spaceship. Driving it is incredibly difficult. I started driving towards something and the ship immediately began breaking apart. Before I could even make it to the thing I was driving to my spaceship leaked too much oxygen and I died.
items.text_zh:
这游戏还需要大量的打磨。

我启动游戏后做的第一件事就是尝试设计我自己的飞船。每次我点击，都没有任何东西被放置上去，所以我没法建造我的飞船。算了，那我就直接玩游戏吧，只不过因为我设计了一艘没有任何部件的飞船，我的太空船就没有任何部件，这意味着我的角色会自动在太空中生成，却没有太空船。真是好玩。

我不得不卸载再重新安装游戏，希望那艘被编辑过的飞船不是永久性的。幸运的是它确实不是，但角色创建的可选项明显非常有限。也许其他职业还没做好，但看到有其他职业选项却没法玩，实在让人恼火。

我设计好了我的角色，有几个如何配置自己的选项，让我很烦的是我没法把在商人空间站买的所有东西都带上，所以它就把我的物品丢在地上，而不是把它们带到我的飞船上。我终于见到了那艘小得可怜、微不足道的飞船。它简直惨不忍睹，但我决定坚持下去，开始驾驶这艘太空船。驾驶它极其困难。我开始朝某个东西开过去，飞船立刻就开始解体。我还没能开到我正驶向的那个东西那里，我的太空船就漏了太多氧气，然后我就死了。
